import os, hashlib, errno
def h(p):
    with open(p,"rb") as f: return hashlib.sha256(f.read()).hexdigest()
inputs_before = h("/inputs/CLAUDE.md")
with open("/work/CLAUDE.md","rb") as f: data=f.read()
src_hash=hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
print("src sha256", src_hash, "len", len(data))
# try atomic rename first
try:
    os.rename("/work/CLAUDE.md","/work/AGENTS.md"); print("rename OK")
except OSError as e:
    print("rename failed:", errno.errorcode[e.errno], e)
    fd=os.open("/work/AGENTS.md", os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL, 0o644)
    with os.fdopen(fd,"wb") as f: f.write(data); f.flush(); os.fsync(f.fileno())
    print("AGENTS.md written; match:", h("/work/AGENTS.md")==src_hash)
    try:
        os.unlink("/work/CLAUDE.md"); print("unlink OK")
    except OSError as e2:
        print("unlink failed:", errno.errorcode[e2.errno], e2)
print("inputs unchanged:", h("/inputs/CLAUDE.md")==inputs_before)
